findings.claim: One of the three reported unguarded DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] accesses remains at TypeCollector.cs:735. The edits only fix the BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull and MemberNeedsKey paths, and ReportIfLocatedInCompilation runs only after a diagnostic has been constructed, so it cannot prevent an IndexOutOfRangeException while obtaining that diagnostic's location. The original metadata record-struct repro can therefore still make GetObjectInfo index an empty DeclaringSyntaxReferences collection, leaving the generator/analyzer crash and missing-resolver requirement unresolved.
